SELECT TOP 2000000
  g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.l, g.b, g.ecl_lat, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.parallax_over_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.ruwe, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.phot_bp_mean_mag, g.phot_rp_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.phot_variable_flag, g.non_single_star, g.ipd_frac_multi_peak, g.phot_bp_rp_excess_factor, g.random_index,
  xw.angular_distance AS wise_angular_distance, xw.number_of_neighbours AS wise_number_of_neighbours, xw.number_of_mates AS wise_number_of_mates, xt.angular_distance AS tmass_angular_distance, xt.number_of_neighbours AS tmass_number_of_neighbours, xt.number_of_mates AS tmass_number_of_mates,
  w.designation AS wise_designation, w.ra AS wise_ra, w.dec AS wise_dec, w.w1mpro AS w1mpro, w.w1mpro_error AS w1mpro_error, w.w2mpro AS w2mpro, w.w2mpro_error AS w2mpro_error, w.w3mpro AS w3mpro, w.w3mpro_error AS w3mpro_error, w.w4mpro AS w4mpro, w.w4mpro_error AS w4mpro_error, w.cc_flags AS cc_flags, w.ext_flag AS ext_flag, w.var_flag AS var_flag, w.ph_qual AS ph_qual, w.w1mjd_mean AS w1mjd_mean, w.w2mjd_mean AS w2mjd_mean,
  t.designation AS tmass_designation, t.j_m AS j_m, t.j_msigcom AS j_msigcom, t.h_m AS h_m, t.h_msigcom AS h_msigcom, t.ks_m AS ks_m, t.ks_msigcom AS ks_msigcom, t.ph_qual AS tmass_ph_qual
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
  JOIN gaiadr3.allwise_best_neighbour AS xw ON xw.source_id = g.source_id
  JOIN gaiadr1.allwise_original_valid AS w ON w.designation = xw.original_ext_source_id
  JOIN gaiadr3.tmass_psc_xsc_best_neighbour AS xt ON xt.source_id = g.source_id
  JOIN gaiadr1.tmass_original_valid AS t ON t.designation = xt.original_ext_source_id
WHERE g.dec >= -65 AND g.dec < -60
  AND g.phot_g_mean_mag < 15
  AND ( (t.ks_m - w.w1mpro) < -0.15
     OR (t.ks_m - w.w2mpro) < -0.15
     OR g.random_index < 9058548 )
